# StaffForge AI Agent Framework — Project Rules
**Version**: v2.7.3 | **Created**: 2026-07-31 08:39:21 UTC | **Status**: Active
**Generated By**: @project-rules (non-interactive defaults) | **Precedence**: conflicts with `AGENTS.md` resolve in favor of this file; `AGENTS_ANEX.md` supersedes base conventions for stated sections only

## Overview
Addendum to `AGENTS.md` defining project settings: tech stack, conventions, constraints, workflow, docs. Read by orchestrator at session start, injected into Compressed Context Block; all subagents receive it on every delegation.

## Technology Stack
- **Languages**: JavaScript (Node.js 20+, ESM), YAML (agent/skill frontmatter)
- **Web Framework**: None — CLI/tooling (Node.js scripts, platform adapters)
- **Database(s)**: None — file-based YAML/JSON configuration
- **Architecture Pattern**: Modular monorepo with platform adapter exporters
- **Testing Framework**: Jest/Vitest (unit) + custom runner (`tests/run-all.mjs`; 31 suites, 848+ tests)
- **DevOps & Deployment**: npm scripts, GitHub Actions (CI), multi-platform export (opencode/claude-code/cursor/copilot/aider/gemini-cli)
- **Validation**: JSON Schema (`schemas/*.json`) via `npm run validate`
- **Routing**: Task → pipeline via `ORCHESTRATOR_MATRIX.md`

## Code Conventions & Standards
- **Variable Naming**: camelCase — JavaScript convention
- **Class/Type Naming**: PascalCase — consistent across files
- **File Naming**: kebab-case for files (e.g. `init-agent.mjs`), snake_case for modules
- **Indentation**: 2 spaces | **Max Line Length**: 100 chars — enforced by Prettier
- **Code Formatter**: Prettier (`.prettierrc`) + ESLint (`.eslintrc.json`)
- **Documentation Format**: JSDoc-style block comments with mandatory coverage for public APIs
- **Agent/Skill Frontmatter**: Explicit `mode`, `tools.write`, `tools.bash`, `tools.edit` — no implicit permissions
- **Agent Files**: Canonical definitions in `agents/*.md`, skills in `skills/*.md`, exported per-platform via adapters

## Operational Rules & Constraints
### Forbidden Operations (NEVER)
- Run VCS commands directly from the orchestrator: delegate branches/commits/merges/tags to `@vcs` — prevents repo corruption
- Work without a task branch: branch creation is mandatory before any work; anything done on develop/main is REJECTED
- Commit, stage, or operate files on protected branches (develop/main) via git agents — only merges and tags permitted there
- Modify `AGENTS.md` directly: `PROJECT_RULES.md` is the addendum — base conventions must stay stable
- Delete or overwrite `PROJECT_RULES.md` without explicit confirmation
- Log secrets, tokens, API keys, or PII: redact in all outputs — never forward raw credentials to subagents
- Commit secrets or env vars: secrets live in env vars only, never in the repo
### Required Approvals
- Architecture / cross-agent contract changes: @architect review (ADR); production deployment: release manager + security sign-off
### Performance & Guardrails Defaults (non-negotiable unless overridden per task)
- CLI startup < 2s cold start; `npm run validate` completes under CI timeout
- **max_iterations**: 10 | **token_budget**: 32000 per call / 128000 per session
- **input_sanitize**: true (prompt-injection prevention before subagent routing) | **DLP redact**: true (secrets, keys, PII redacted in all prompts/outputs)
### Security Constraints
- Never log secrets/tokens: redact in all outputs
- All agent frontmatter permissions explicit: no implicit full-access grants
- Sanitize user input to prevent prompt injection; code-generating subagents follow Security by Design and OWASP Top 10
### Data Handling Rules
- No PII stored in repo: configuration is code-only; secrets via env vars, never committed
### Deployment Rules
- Only `hotfix/*` and `release/*` touch main: feature/bugfix merge to develop only; rollback via tag-based revert through `@vcs`

## Workflow & Process Definition
### Version Control Strategy
- **Branching Model**: Git Flow — `feature/*`/`bugfix/*` → develop; `release/*`/`hotfix/*` → main
- **Commit Message Format**: Conventional Commits — `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`
- **Versioning Scheme**: Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), current v2.7.3
- **VCS Delegation**: Orchestrator creates the task branch as its very first action, then delegates all VCS operations to `@vcs`; only the orchestrator communicates with the user
### Pipeline Routing (ORCHESTRATOR_MATRIX.md)
- Feature → VCS → Planner → [Requirements+Architect] → Knowledge → Impact → [Language+Security+Testing] → [Code Review+Documentation] → VCS merge
- Bug → VCS → Planner → [Knowledge+Impact] → Debugging → [Language+Testing] → Code Review → VCS merge
- Refactor → VCS → Architect → [Refactor+Performance] → Code Review → VCS merge
- Security → VCS → Security → Pentest → Code Review → VCS merge
- Deployment → VCS → [Docker+Kubernetes] → [Build+Release] → Documentation → VCS (main + tag + develop + cleanup)
- Hotfix → VCS (from main) → Debugging → Code Review → VCS (main + tag + develop + cleanup)
### Code Review Process
- **Minimum Reviewers**: 1 | **Approval**: ≥1 maintainer | **Timeline**: within 3 business days
- **Automated Checks**: `npm run validate` + `npm test` must pass in CI
### Issue & Task Management
- **Tool**: GitHub Issues | **Labeling**: feature / bug / refactor / security / docs | **Assignment**: assignee field
### Release & Deployment Workflow
- **Frequency**: On-demand per `release/*` | **Process**: Hybrid (CI build + manual tag) | **Rollback**: manual revert of tagged commit | **Canary**: No
### Decision Making & Communication
- **Decision Documentation**: ADRs in repo (`docs/adr/`) | **Channels**: GitHub Discussions | **Meetings**: weekly maintainer sync

## Documentation Requirements
### Documentation Scope & Coverage
- **Architecture**: Required — `ARCHITECTURE.md` + `ORCHESTRATOR_MATRIX.md` in repo
- **API Specifications**: Required for published packages — JSDoc
- **Deployment Guides**: Required — `README.md` + per-platform export docs
- **Module READMEs**: Required sections for `packages/` (name, usage, API); operational runbooks optional
### Documentation Tools & Standards
- **Format**: Markdown in repo (`docs/` + root `.md` files), in-repo version control, Markdown + JSDoc + OpenAPI where applicable
- **Code Comments**: Mandatory for public APIs
- **Change Logs**: Required — `CHANGELOG.md` (Keep a Changelog format)
- **Deprecation Notice**: 1 minor release notice before removal | **Migration Guides**: required for breaking changes
- **Canonical Docs**: `AGENTS.md` is canonical; `AGENTS_ANEX.md` is the annex (extends/overrides with explicit precedence)
- **Review**: Included in code review; approval required (maintainer)

## AI Agent Guidelines
- **Output Language**: English only — optimal subagent prompting efficiency and lowest token footprint
- **Token Optimization Standard**: Compress and summarize context before routing; never pass full raw histories to subagents — extract only necessary code snippets and constraints; use structured JSON/Markdown for agent-to-agent communication instead of conversational prose
- **Subagent Contract**: Subagents return findings/risks/recommendations, never final user output; no subagent talks to the user or manages VCS
- **VCS Boundary**: Only the orchestrator communicates with the user or creates branches/commits — and it delegates VCS execution to `@vcs`
- **Mode Rules**: Orchestrator is the default agent; subagents invoked via @mention with explicit tool permissions
- **Hallucination Guard**: Never fabricate missing specs — make a safe standard assumption, state it explicitly, and proceed
- **No Placeholders**: Do not generate `// TODO` stubs or placeholder code; deliver production-ready output
- **Ambiguity**: Escalate ambiguities to the orchestrator; never stall on safe defaults
